technical_rule: sign of preceding15minute return; other technical features retained, no threshold optimization
interpretation_rule: one noncontradictory policy stance/action/change sign per currency; relative pair base minus quote sign; retrospective price responses and opinions excluded from news direction
original_rule: stored currency_scores sign(base-quote); original publish eligibility retained as separate stratum
dedup: normalized identical headline after trailing publisher suffix removal; earliest first_seen; then one pair observation per15minute clock bucket; selection by clock/event id only
evaluation: new interpreter applied now; decisions use stored known clocks, max180sec technical age; first subsequent completed candle entry; bidask endpoints; no fits/no live forecast claims
scope: descriptive archive batch; reused inspected dates; no holdout or significance claim; shared stories/pairs correlated
